author: fwyzard
body:
#### PR description:

`RefCoreStreamerGuard` reset the thread's product getter to `nullptr` when destroyed, clearing the getter of an outer guard on the same thread, _e.g._ when a TBB task that reads `RefCores` runs while the thread waits inside a delayed read.

Restore the previous getter instead, and keep the current one when the guard is given a null getter.

Add a unit test for nested guards.

#### PR validation:

All unit tests pass.
title: Restore the previous product getter in `RefCoreStreamerGuard`
